text.tspan: Daily cron /api/cron/checkpoints (01:00 UTC)
Active checkpoints whose today is a sprint's last day (7, 14, 21, 28)
The team: confirmed TeamMember rows (not finished; the author is one),
the curator excluded; one CheckpointPulse per person and sprint
(@@unique checkpoint, member, week)
Yes: wrote a devlog of the project in the sprint
or created one of its artifacts in the sprint
→ pulse confirmed now, source 'devlog' / 'artifact', no letter
No → pulse row with requestedAt = now
→ letter (bell + email, transactionId per pulse):
'Were you working on <project> this sprint?'
'… If you weren't working on it this sprint, ignore this email.'
button → /pulse/<token>
token = pulseId + '.' + HMAC-SHA256(NEXTAUTH_SECRET, 'pulse:' + pulseId)
no login needed: the link itself says who and which sprint
POST /api/pulse/<token> — the button
same checks; confirmedAt = now, source 'email'
only if still unconfirmed (updateMany … confirmedAt: null)
→ page switches to 09.2 in place: this sprint's cell turns ✓
The pulse matrix on the path and the curator's card
(already built) reads these rows
09.1 Were you working… [Yes, I was]
with the person's four sprint cells:
confirmed ✓ · missed – · this one waiting · ahead empty
past the sprint's next call
(session sprint+1, or day 29's call for sprint 4)
